transcript.text: Back in 2025 I was bouncing around a lot—one week I ended up in Hangzhou for a couple days and basically just wandered and ate my way through the city.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier that same spring I’d already done that classic high-speed hop from Beijing down to Shanghai—felt like half the train was commuting.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Then a few days later I was in Chengdu too, which was honestly the most laid-back part of the whole stretch.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the Beijing-to-Shanghai leg, the ticket had already been issued as train G3 on 2025-03-15, and it was under Aiden Miller.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember it was Second Class, which was totally fine—just the usual shuffle with bags and people swapping seats at first.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Hangzhou, Gao Yan had already arranged the stay at West Lake State Guesthouse—check-in was 2025-03-24 and it was for 2 nights.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And in Chengdu, Lin Bo had already sorted the Kuanzhai Alley visit for 2025-03-22 in the morning, with 4 tickets for the group.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Negative intent: the user is reminiscing about past trips and already-issued bookings; no request for help or action is implied.
